id.description:
Quote ID

**NOTE**:
If not specified during creation, this attribute is automatically generated. It is also possible to assign a custom ID.

customerReference.description: Customer-provided reference stored on the quote.

customerComment.description: Customer-provided comment stored on the quote.

customer.description: This attribute contains details about the customer for whom the quote was created.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer for whom the quote was created.

firstName.description:
Customer's first name

**NOTE**:
This attribute is filled automatically after the quote is created.

lastName.description:
Customer's last name

**NOTE**:
This attribute is filled automatically after the quote is created.

contactEmail.description:
Customer's contact email

**NOTE**:
This attribute is filled automatically after the quote is created.

employee.description: This attribute contains details about the employee that is processing the quote.

employeeId.description: The ID of the employee that is processing the quote.

firstName.description:
Employee's first name

**NOTE**:
This attribute is filled automatically after the quote is created or the employee ID is updated.

lastName.description:
Employee's last name.

**NOTE**:
This attribute is filled automatically after the quote is created or the employee ID is updated.

cartId.description: The ID of the cart from which the quote was created (not available when the quote was created manually)

legalEntityId.description: Identifier of the legal entity linked to the quote.

company.description: **This field is deprecated**. Use `legalEntityId` to identify the company. The object remains populated for compatibility and contains the company name stored on the quote.

name.description: The company name for which the quote was created.

siteCode.description: The site code for which the quote was created

orderId.description: The ID of the order which was created based on the quote. The order is created and assigned to the quote when status of the quote transitions to `ACCEPTED`.

currency.description: The currency of the quote prices.

value.description: The status value of the quote.

validTo.description: The date until which the quote is valid and can be accepted by the customer.

taxValue.description: The amount of the tax for the total price.

taxAggregate.description: Tax aggregation of the total price.

grossValue.description: Gross value of the shipping cost.

methodName.description: Localized name of the shipping method selected by the customer.

id.description: The ID of the quote item used for patch operations on the item.

quantity.description: The attribute contains details about the item quantity.
The quantity of the item that is used for the price calculation.

unitCode.description: The unit code of the quantity (it must be one of the units defined in the Unit Handling Service).

type.description: Defines if product is external or internal. If the product is internal, it's taken from the Emporix Product Service. If the price is external, it's a custom product from external system.

priceId.description: The ID of the price that was initially assigned to the item.

unitPrice.description: The original unit price of the item that is copied from the initial price.

newUnitPrice.description: The new unit price that is auto-calculated based on provided `quantity` and `totalNetValue` values.

discount.description: The difference in percentage between `unitPrice` and `newUnitPrice`.

totalNetValue.description: The total net price of the item that is initially based on the provided price, but it can be overridden to allow for a merchant discount.

tax.description: This attribute contains information about the calculated item tax.

taxClass.description: The tax class assigned to the item is initially copied from the initial price.

taxRate.description: The tax rate that is copied from the initial price.

prices.description: The auto-calculated item net and gross prices

type.description: Defines if product is external or internal. If the product is internal, it's taken from the Emporix Product Service. If the price is external, it's a custom product from external system.

productId.description: The ID of the product or variant assigned to the quote item.

name.description:
This attribute contains the product name language map.

**NOTE**:
After the item has been added to the quote, the product name language map attribute is automatically populated.

media.description: This attribute comprises the product media information and is automatically populated upon the creation of the quote.

contentType.description: The content type of the media. For example: `image/jpg`.

url.description: The url to the product media.

taxClasses.description: Map of key-value pairs that associates tax classes with locations (countries).

version.description: Version of the quote that is used for the optimistic locking handling.

postcode.description: The postal code of the city.

state.description: The state where the city is located.

countryCode.description: The code of the country location.

message.description: Localized message - can be either string or map with languages as map's keys accordingly to specified 'Accept-Language' header.

code.description: Code of the reason for the quote status change.

version.description: Version of the quote reason that is used for the optimistic locking handling.

QuoteShipping.description: The shipping cost of the quote.

value.description: Net value of the shipping cost.

shippingTaxCode.description: Tax code of the shipping method.

Restriction.description:
Access control identifier that determines who can view or manage the quotes.

**Purpose**: Restricts quote visibility based on scope permissions. Only users/applications 
with matching restriction scopes can access quotes with a specific restriction value.

**Access Control**:
- *Reading*: Users can only query and view quotes with the `restriction` value that matches one of their authorized restrictions.

**Validation**: The value must exist in the tenant's configured list of valid restrictions.

**Restriction Synchronization**:
- If quote is created by a customer (based on a cart) and `restriction` property is not set, the `restriction` value of quote is inherited from customer's restriction.
- If a quote is created by an employee and the `restriction` property is not set with tenant configuration property `enableSyncBetweenRestrictionsAndSiteCodes` set to `true`, the `restriction` field automatically syncs with quote's siteCode property.
